map.根据肤色深浅与冷暖色调，推荐粉底色号与选色技巧。: Recommend a foundation shade and selection tips based on your skin depth and undertone.
map.选择肤色与色调后点击匹配。: Pick your skin depth and undertone, then click match.
map.在下巴与脖子交界处试色，而非手背。: Swatch on the jawline where it meets the neck, not the back of the hand.
map.等待 30 秒观察粉底与肤色融合后的效果。: Wait 30 seconds to see how the foundation settles into your skin tone.
map.自然光下判断最准确。: Natural daylight gives the most accurate read.
map.色号应“隐形”，与肤色过渡自然。: The shade should be invisible, blending naturally into your skin.
map.专柜试色困难，想根据肤色明度与冷暖调选接近的粉底色号。: Counter swatching is hard, so you want to pick a foundation shade close to your skin depth and undertone.
map.网购粉底怕色差，先用自评确定色调再对照品牌色卡。: Afraid of a colour mismatch when buying foundation online? Self-assess the undertone first, then compare with the brand's shade chart.
map.化妆师为新娘试妆前快速锁定 2–3 个候选色号。: A makeup artist quickly narrows candidates down to 2-3 shades before a bride's trial session.
map.设肤色明度 L = 62（中调）、血管测试偏绿（暖黄调），则对应暖调（黄底）粉底: Set skin lightness L = 62 (medium) and the vein test leaning green (warm yellow). That maps to a warm (yellow-based) foundation; take a warm shade with L close to 62 from the brand chart (for example natural 03) and swatch at the jawline-neck junction for the most accurate read. Cool pink undertones tend to look grey on the face.
map.怎么判断自己是冷调还是暖调？: How do I tell whether I am cool or warm?
map.看手腕血管：偏蓝紫为冷调、偏绿为暖调；或戴金银饰，金显气质好多为暖调、银显好多为: Look at the veins on your wrist: blue-purple means cool, green means warm. Alternatively try gold and silver jewellery — if gold flatters you more you are usually warm, if silver flatters you more you are cool. Neutral undertones suit both.
map.为什么专柜试色要涂在下颌？: Why should I swatch on the jawline at a counter?
map.下颌连接面部与颈部，该处颜色最接近整体肤色且不易受局部泛红影响，能避免脸颈色差。: The jaw connects the face and the neck, so that area is closest to your overall skin colour and less affected by local redness, which avoids a face-neck colour difference.
